nodes.label: Enforcement
nodes.summary: The enforcement powers and disciplinary mechanisms available to the SFC, HKEX, and the Market Misconduct Tribunal for breaches of listing rules, securities laws, and market misconduct provisions.

nodes.label: SFC Enforcement Powers
nodes.summary: The SFC has broad investigatory and enforcement powers under the SFO, including the power to investigate, discipline licensed persons, suspend trading, and prosecute market misconduct.

nodes.label: SFO s.179 — SFC Investigatory Powers
nodes.summary: The SFC may require production of documents, attend for examination, and enter premises to investigate suspected breaches.

nodes.label: SFO s.182 — Disciplinary Powers over Licensed Persons
nodes.summary: The SFC may reprimand, fine, suspend, or revoke licences of regulated persons for misconduct.

nodes.label: SFO s.194 — Power to Suspend Trading
nodes.summary: The SFC may direct the Exchange to suspend trading in any listed securities if it considers it in the public interest.

nodes.label: SFO s.195 — Power to Restrain Proceedings
nodes.summary: The SFC may apply to the court for injunctions or other orders to restrain breaches or preserve assets.

nodes.label: HKEX Disciplinary Powers
nodes.summary: HKEX has contractual disciplinary powers under the Listing Rules, including the Listing Committee and Listing Review Committee, to impose sanctions on issuers and directors for Rule breaches.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.02 — Listing Committee Powers
nodes.summary: The Listing Committee may investigate, hear, and determine disciplinary proceedings for Listing Rule breaches.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.09 — Sanctions
nodes.summary: Sanctions available include public censure, fines (up to HK$30 million), suspension, cancellation of listing, and director unsuitability statements.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 2A.10 — Review of Listing Committee Decisions
nodes.summary: The Listing Review Committee reviews decisions of the Listing Committee upon application.

nodes.label: HKEX v Hontex International Holdings Ltd (2012) — Listing Cancellation
nodes.summary: HKEX suspended and cancelled Hontex's listing for materially false or misleading information in its prospectus; the first cancellation of its kind.

nodes.label: HKEX v HCIG (2019) — Fine and Censure
nodes.summary: Listco fined HK$27 million and directors publicly censured for failing to comply with connected transaction rules.

nodes.label: Market Misconduct Regime
nodes.summary: The SFO establishes a dual civil/criminal regime for market misconduct (insider dealing, false trading, price rigging, and market manipulation). The Market Misconduct Tribunal hears civil cases.

nodes.label: SFO s.270 — Insider Dealing
nodes.summary: Prohibition on insider dealing; applies to listed securities, derivatives, and structured products.

nodes.label: SFO s.277 — Market Misconduct Tribunal
nodes.summary: The Market Misconduct Tribunal may hear insider dealing and other market misconduct cases and impose civil sanctions.

nodes.label: SFO s.285 — MMT Sanctions
nodes.summary: Sanctions include disqualification (up to 5 years), disgorgement of profits, fines (up to 3x profit), and cold shoulder orders.

nodes.label: MMT v Tiger Asia (2014) — Insider Dealing
nodes.summary: Market Misconduct Tribunal found Tiger Asia engaged in insider dealing; fined and ordered disgorgement.

nodes.label: MMT v Du Jun (2017) — Insider Dealing
nodes.summary: Former UBS banker Du Jun convicted of insider dealing by MMT; ordered to disgorge HK$16.4 million and disqualified for 5 years.

nodes.label: Detection and Investigation
nodes.summary: Step 1: SFC or HKEX detects potential breach via market surveillance, complaint, or referral.

nodes.label: Investigation Commenced
nodes.summary: Step 2: Statutory investigation under SFO s.179 — document production, examination, premises search.

nodes.label: Disciplinary Referral or Court Action
nodes.summary: Step 3: Matter referred to HKEX Listing Committee, MMT, or criminal prosecution depending on nature and severity.

nodes.label: Sanction and Remediation
nodes.summary: Step 4: Sanctions imposed — fine, suspension, cancellation, disqualification, or criminal penalty.
